WITH maint AS (
    SELECT 
        m.powerref,
        SUM(m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) AS total_maint_cost,
        SUM(m.revlossusd) AS total_rev_loss
    FROM maintenance m
    GROUP BY m.powerref
),
alerts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.compreg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN a.alertstat = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_critical_alert
    FROM alerts a
    GROUP BY a.compreg
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        p.growregistry,
        p.growalias AS plant_name,
        p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
        COALESCE(m.total_maint_cost, 0) AS total_maintenance_costs,
        COALESCE(m.total_rev_loss, 0) AS revenue_losses,
        CASE WHEN p.gencapmw > 0 
            THEN COALESCE(m.total_maint_cost, 0) / p.gencapmw 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS mce_score,
        CASE WHEN p.gencapmw > 0 
            THEN COALESCE(m.total_rev_loss, 0) / p.gencapmw 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS revenue_loss_rate,
        COALESCE(a.has_critical_alert, 0) AS has_critical
    FROM plant p
    LEFT JOIN maint m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
    LEFT JOIN alerts a ON p.growregistry = a.compreg
)
SELECT 
    plant_name,
    capacity_mw,
    total_maintenance_costs,
    revenue_losses,
    ROUND(CAST(mce_score AS numeric), 2) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
    ROUND(CAST(revenue_loss_rate AS numeric), 2) AS revenue_loss_rate,
    CASE WHEN mce_score > 0 
        THEN ROUND(CAST((revenue_loss_rate / mce_score) AS numeric), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS mroi_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN has_critical = 1 AND (revenue_loss_rate / NULLIF(mce_score, 0)) > 2.0 THEN 'URGENT'
        WHEN has_critical = 1 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN (revenue_loss_rate / NULLIF(mce_score, 0)) > 2.0 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS priority_level
FROM combined
ORDER BY priority_level, mroi_value DESC
